name: United Kingdom

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. United Kingdom mid-2025 population estimate of the Office for National Statistics, 69 487 000 inhabitants, published 27 November 2025, read on the ONS population estimates page. Eurostat was deliberately not used here: its demo_pjan series stops at 1 January 2020 for the United Kingdom, a consequence of the country leaving the Union, and a five-year-old figure was refused when the national statistical institute publishes a current one. Note the reference differs from the rest of the series: ONS gives a mid-year estimate, Eurostat a 1 January stock. The gap is a few months of growth and is not material at the precision this indicator uses, but it is recorded rather than hidden.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained, on a recent and documented closure. The Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, part of the University of London, carried the United Kingdom's first university puppetry award, the BA in Puppetry: Design and Performance, the country's only puppetry BA and a pillar of the school's training for more than twenty-five years. That course has taken no new students since the 2018-19 academic year and is no longer taught; puppetry survives as a component embedded in other courses, from Theatre Practice to Acting and Applied Theatre. A puppetry master's is announced as in development, with no source establishing that it has opened. As things stand no training satisfies the denominator and the value moves from 0.5 to 0. Upper bound at 1 to carry that announced master's: if its opening is confirmed, the United Kingdom returns to 1. Estimate, the school's site refusing automated reading.
